ukodb_WorkstationAccess Allow Workstation access to my userid 1.0.0.0
IBM
5655-EKM UKO V2R1+ ukodb
&variables;
Give me access to the Workstation Gives access to the Workstation to the executing userid $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
Submit jcl to execute step 1 true
extensions/giveMeWorkstationAccess.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024
Prepare cleanup script to be able to remove all users All users need to get removed from the group again, otherwise it can't get deleted $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
Submit shell script to execute step 1 true
#if(${instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} && ${instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} != "") userid=${instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} #else userid=${_step-stepOwnerUpper} #end
if [ -d "/u/${userid}" ] then folder=/u/${userid} else useridLC=$(echo "${userid}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') folder=/u/${useridLC} fi echo "adding command to delete user from groups again in ${userid}'s home directory ${folder}" echo "filename is ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx"
if [ ! -f "${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx" ] then echo "creating script from scratch" echo "/* REXX */\naddress tso\n" > ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx chown ${instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx chmod 755 ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx else echo "adding to existing script" fi echo "Say \"Remove ${_step-stepOwnerUpper} from ${instance-UKO_AGENT_CLIENT_GROUP} and (${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA})\"" echo "\"REMOVE ${_step-stepOwnerUpper} GROUP(${instance-UKO_AGENT_CLIENT_GROUP})\"\n" >> ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx echo "\"REMOVE ${_step-stepOwnerUpper} GROUP(${instance-DB_CURRENT_SCHEMA})\"\n" >> ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx echo "current script:" cat ${folder}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}-users.rexx
shell-JCL
